_comment: Model lineup fixed by Nathan (generator -> gpt-6-luna, 01:48) (agentctl post 2026-11-15 00:32/00:40). roles: autoresearch backend:model specs (llm.get_llm); petri: Inspect model ids for harness/petri/run_audits.py. dev_target.cost_note: billed per GPU-second, not per token: one H100 at Modal list price (about $3.95/h at the time of writing; check modal.com/pricing). Scales to zero after 15 idle minutes.

waivers.reason: generator moved to openai:gpt-6-luna while J2 stays openai:gpt-5.1; accepted trade-off. Adding a third-family held-out judge (e.g. openai-compat:deepseek/deepseek-v3.2, probe set already in evaldetect_probes.json) would remove this waiver
